A '''camp''' of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] was located near [[Jundland Station]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was destroyed during the [[Second Battle of Tatooine]].
